Title: Source 2: Bethlehem Steel Works, Pennsylvania (1912)
Content: Bethlehem Steel was an iron company established in `text(1857)`. It became the `text(second)` largest steel producer in the United States. Steel from the Bethlehem mills was used to build ships and skyscrapers. Steel mills were located near waterways and railroad lines. This made it easier to transport natural resources and finished products.
